messages.author: player_a
messages.text: did you try the new ranked mode yet

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: yeah, the map rotation is way better now

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: same, i finally pushed my score above 1800

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: nice, i keep losing because i overextend

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: try playing safer until the last circle

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: good call, i should stop chasing every fight

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: who is your favourite character right now

messages.text: i still like the sniper because the utility is strong

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: mine is the tank, mostly because i like front line plays

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: makes sense, your aggressive style fits that role

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: what skin are you using this week

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: the blue one from the winter event

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: that one looks clean, i need to unlock it too

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: the grind is worth it if you want the emote

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: yeah, the emote is probably my favourite part

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: should we queue another match after this

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: definitely, i want to test that new strategy

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: cool, maybe we can try a defensive setup first

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: good idea, and then rotate early for the high ground

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: works for me, better than rushing every round

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: also, did you see the patch notes for the new weapon balance

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: yeah, the damage nerf makes sense honestly

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: i agree, it should make matches feel less spammy

messages.author: player_b
messages.text: alright, queue me up after i grab some water

messages.author: player_a
messages.text: cool, text me when you're back and we start
